_about: Settings for the Training page (training the handwriting reader on your own forms).
test_every: every Nth form uploaded is kept aside as a test form (1st, 11th, 21st... for 10).
Test forms are checked like the others but never used for training; they measure
whether a newly trained model reads better than the one in use.
few / enough: samples of one character below 'few' = needs more; from 'enough' on = enough.
accuracy_low / accuracy_ok: share of a character read right first time (on checked forms):
below accuracy_low = often misread; below accuracy_ok = sometimes misread.
min_seen: a character's accuracy is only judged after it was seen this many times.
retrain_after: new characters collected since the last training before training is advised.
min_samples_to_train: training is refused below this many collected characters.
min_test_forms: fewer test forms than this = the old/new comparison is not reliable yet.
cnn_epochs: training rounds for the main model (3 = about 10-15 minutes on a normal CPU).
